meta.name: doc-parse
meta.description: 将 PDF/PPT/Excel/Word 等多格式文档解析为结构化 Markdown，并输出元数据与解析置信度，作为 RAG 与四色卡片的数据底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PDF/PPT/Excel/Word 文档解析为结构化 Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要把各种办公文档转成结构化文本，供知识库或检索使用
copy.tagline_en: Parse PDF, PPT, Excel and Word into structured Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to convert various office documents into clean structured Markdown for reuse

howto.what: 把 PDF、PPT、Excel、Word 等文档解析成结构化 Markdown，同时给出标题、页数、表格数等元数据和 0–1 的解析置信度，并注明最终生效的解析器。
howto.when: 由密卷房 Worker 在收到已通过安全扫描的文件时调用；解析器按三级 fallback 依次尝试，全部失败则标记人工介入。

say.text: 把这个 PDF 解析成结构化 Markdown，并给出置信度
say.note: 输出正文、元数据和 0–1 置信度

say.text: 用 doc-parse 处理这份 Excel，说明用了哪个解析器
say.note: 返回 fallback_used 解析器名称

say.text: 解析这份 Word 的表格，低置信度的块标出来
say.note: 块级失败仅标记该块低置信度

howto.what_en: Turns PDF, PPT, Excel and Word files into structured Markdown, plus metadata such as title, page count and table count, a 0–1 parse confidence, and the name of the parser that finally ran.
howto.when_en: Called by the 密卷房 Worker when it receives a file that has passed security-scan; three fallback parsers are tried in order, and if all fail the file is marked for manual handling.

say_en.text: Parse this PDF into structured Markdown and give me the confidence score
say_en.note: Returns body, metadata and a 0–1 confidence

say_en.text: Run doc-parse on this Excel and tell me which parser was used
Parse the tables in this Word file and flag low-confidence blocks
say_en.note: Block-level failures are marked low confidence
